effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Leopardmon] in its text and 1 Digimon card with [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign], other than [Sea Animal], in any of its traits among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] All of your suspended Digimon get +1000 DP.
